# attested in source

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInSource>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)

The bibliographic or documentary source in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may be supported by multiple sources, and competing source attributions coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Targets a [`CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) (the retired Source Kind was greenfield-refactored in).
